problem:
Consider the differential equation

$$
\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+\frac{3}{x}y=\frac{{e}^{x}}{{x}^{3}},\,x>0.

Select the correct options below.$\,$ An integrating factor for this equation is $I(x)=$ {{field-1}}.

Question 6
?
Consider the differential equation dydx+3xy=exx3,x>0. Select the correct options below. An integrating factor for this equation is I(x)=
 
3x
ex3
x3
e3/x
.

The general solution is given by y(x)=
 
ex+Cx3
ex+Cx2
x2(ex+C)
x3(ex+C)
.
Submit
